whoWeAre.p1: EMI Automation is a Malaysian technology company working where industrial automation meets enterprise IT. We supply and integrate PLC, VFD and instrumentation systems, deliver and maintain server and network infrastructure, and are an appointed reseller of Materialise software in Malaysia.
whoWeAre.p2: Our customers are manufacturers, water utilities, data centres, retail groups, hospitals, universities and research institutes across Peninsular Malaysia. One supplier, one purchase order, one local contact — from a control panel or a server fleet to a software licence and the workstation that runs it.

lines.head: Materialise software licences
lines.body: Appointed reseller of Materialise software in Malaysia — Mimics®, 3-matic® and the wider Materialise portfolio — for hospitals, universities, research institutes and manufacturers.

lines.head: IT infrastructure
lines.body: Server supply, maintenance and replacement (HP ProLiant, Dell PowerEdge, IBM), rack systems and PDUs, storage and RAID, firmware and BIOS, network verification, AV and workstation deployment.

lines.head: Automation & instrumentation
lines.body: PLC and VFD control panels, HMI, telemetry and instrumentation (flow, level, pressure), E&I installation, testing and commissioning, and IT–OT integration.

materialise.title: Materialise software licences
materialise.intro: EMI Automation is an appointed reseller of Materialise software in Malaysia. We bring Materialise’s image-based engineering software, including Mimics® and 3-matic®, to hospitals, universities, research institutes and manufacturers.
materialise.terms: Materialise develops and licenses the software; use is governed by the Materialise End-User License Agreement. Our commercial terms are stated on each quotation.

team.title: A small team with the whole stack
team.coverage: Peninsular Malaysia, from Kuala Lumpur and Nilai. On-site deployment, testing and commissioning by our own engineers; consultation in English, Bahasa Malaysia and Mandarin.
team.support: One local contact for every product we supply. Manufacturer support routed and followed up by us; software licence queries and renewals tracked to expiry.

blocks.head: Quality
blocks.body: Every product is supplied with the manufacturer’s warranty and documentation. We keep serial, licence and delivery records for every order, and pass product complaints to the manufacturer without delay.

blocks.head: Integrity
blocks.body: Our Code of Conduct & Anti-Bribery Policy (effective 1 January 2025) sets a zero-tolerance standard on bribery and corruption in line with the MACC Act 2009, section 17A, with gifts and hospitality rules, whistleblowing protection and record-keeping.

blocks.head: Compliance
blocks.body: Registered with the Companies Commission of Malaysia. Company documents — SSM profile, bank confirmation, policies and declarations — are available for vendor registration on request. Personal data is handled in line with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010.

blocks.head: Commercial terms
blocks.body: Quotations in Ringgit Malaysia; payment terms stated on each quotation. EMI Automation is not registered for Sales and Service Tax. Software licences are delivered electronically and governed by the publisher’s licence agreement.
